title: What needs doing
subtitle: Everything below is a real count. Click any of them to go to the list it came from.

loadsAvailable.label: Loads without a carrier
loadsAvailable.hint: Booked and nobody is hauling them yet.

loadsInTransit.label: On the road
loadsInTransit.hint: Picked up and not yet delivered.

loadsDelivered.label: Delivered
loadsDelivered.hint: Delivered and not yet moved on.

loadsUninvoiced.label: Delivered, not invoiced
loadsUninvoiced.hint: Work done that nobody has billed. It does not show up in any report, because reports count what was invoiced.

documentsExpiring.label: Documents expiring
documentsExpiring.hint: Already expired or inside the warning window your company set.

carriersFmcsaStale.label: Carriers to re-verify
carriersFmcsaStale.hint: No FMCSA check within the period your company set — including those never checked.

invoicesOverdue.label: Overdue invoices
invoicesOverdue.hint: Past their due date with money still owed.

settlementsDraft.label: Settlements in draft
settlementsDraft.hint: Prepared and not issued to the carrier yet.

commissionsAccrued.label: Commissions owed
commissionsAccrued.hint: Earned on invoiced loads and not paid out yet.

leadsUnassigned.label: Leads with no owner
leadsUnassigned.hint: Somebody wrote in and nobody has taken it.

empty.title: Nothing pending
empty.body: Nothing your role can see needs attention right now.

permissions.title: What this user can do
permissions.hint: The permission matrix lives in code. It is shown here so that a wrong scope can be pointed at.
